taskPurpose.exactNormativeText: Research budget is partitioned among exploitation, uncertainty, stratified random exploration, source exploration, and protected risk/outcome workloads.
Every randomized assignment stores eligibility universe, stratum, policy version, assignment probability, seed/entropy provenance, and inclusion timestamp.
Outcome-dependent, zero-probability, corrupted, or undocumented assignments cannot support universe-wide weighted claims.
Exploration constraints limit critical security exposure, quota, duplication, narrative concentration, and candidate count while preserving representative sampling.
Bandit/reallocation policies remain shadow until off-policy or forward evaluation proves value without degrading coverage or creating bias.
Exploitation cannot consume the configured minimum exploration allocation except under an audited emergency reserve policy.
